notes.title: Neon Nights 2 is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42669411/e012e958e14eae3621fe7bc3879e15590402959d.png[/img]

[h2]I'm excited to announce that Neon Nights 2 is Steam Deck Verified and is now playable on Steam Deck!

When you lay your hands on Valve's new console, you'll be able to bring Neon Nights 2 adventure with you anywhere you go![/h2]

notes.title: Artbook - Free DLC Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42669411/1d873fd44154f189f2a0e7749e4bf2ad8ecc6c4a.png[/img]

[h2][b]3D Renders, Illustrations and Animations![/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]300+ high-quality 4k images in JPG format
[*]17 Animations
[/list]

[h2][b]NOTE: To access the Digital Artbook:[/b][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Right click "Neon Nights 2" in the Steam Library
[*] Go to Properties > Local Files > Browse Local Files
[*] Open the "Artbook" folder 
[/olist]
